back: Yes — both are given. You still need to know how to interpret $\Delta$.

front: Discriminant condition for: "touches / tangent", "does not meet", "real roots"?
back: Tangent or equal roots: $\Delta = 0$. Does not meet: $\Delta < 0$. Real roots: $\Delta \ge 0$. Two distinct real roots: $\Delta > 0$.
